resolved.title: 字典 Map
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Maps[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Maps are used to store [b]key:value[/b] pairs.
The key is always unique.

We can create a map using the [b]make[/b]() function, similar to arrays:[code format="go" ] m := make(map[string]int) [/code]
Now, [b]m[/b] is a map that maps a [b]string[/b] key to an [b]integer[/b] value.
Let's add some values to the map and output an element:[code format="go" codeId="3352"]m["James"] = 42
m["Amy"] = 24

fmt.Println(m["James"])[/code]
You can also initialize a map using the following syntax:[code format="go" codeId="3353"]m := map[string]int{
  "James": 42, 
  "Amy": 24}

fmt.Println(m["Amy"])[/code]
If the requested key does not exist in the map, a zero value will be returned.
[note]Maps are also called dictionaries, associative arrays, or hash tables.[/note]

content.text:
现在，**m**是一个字典，它将一个**字符串**键映射到一个**整数**值。
让我们在字典上添加一些值，并输出一个元素：
content.text_html:
Now, m is a map that maps a string key to an integer value. Let's add some values to the map and output an element:

现在，m是一个地图，它将一个字符串键映射到一个整数值。 让我们在地图上添加一些值，并输出一个元素。

content.content:
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
    m := make(map[string]int)
    m["James"] = 42
    m["Amy"] = 24

    fmt.Println(m["James"])
}

You can use the [b]delete[/b] function to remove an element from the map:[code format="go" codeId="3354"]delete(m, "James") [/code]
This will remove the element with the key "James" from the map [b]m[/b].

To add a new element to the map, you simply assign that key a new value:[code format="go" codeId="3355"]m["Bob"] = 8 [/code]
[note]Maps are printed in the form [b]map[key:value key:value][/b] when output with [b]fmt.Println()[/b].[/note]

resolved.title: 平均高度
resolved.problem_statement_md:
一个篮球队的身高存储在一个**字典**中。
请计算并输出该队的**平均**高度。

使用一个**for**循环来遍历字典并计算出平均高度。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Average Height[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The heights of a basketball team are stored in a [b]map[/b].
You need to calculate and output the [b]average[/b] height of the team.

Use a [b]for[/b] loop to iterate over the map and calculate the average height.
[note]To find the average, you need to calculate the sum of all the heights and divide it by the number of players.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 为了找到平均数，需要计算所有身高的总和并除以球员的数量。

```go
fmt.Println(m[4]-m[5])
```
